ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: PR Writing A limited number of seats are available to juniors and seniors in the Broadcast and News Editorial journalism majors. Please contact the College of Media course scheduler, Michele Andrews at mldrews@illinois.edu or 244-1810 for further assistance.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Speech Communication or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Media Studies or Communication or Media and Cinema Studies major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
